generationRule: Paths to prompt files are relative to assets/space. Final prompt = master style + two newlines + source prompt + generationSuffix. promptOverride replaces that combination where present. Edits are subsequent prompts with the generated image as edit target. transparent specifies transparent_background.

assets.name: 01_background_gameplay
assets.promptOverride: Create a vertical 9:16 mobile game background for GridNova Sudoku. Calm bright orbital platform, a large soft-focus moon far in the background at the edge, subtle floating asteroids and distant structures, atmospheric haze below. Middle 60% visually quiet negative space for Sudoku. More detail only near corners. Light space pastel sci-fi, premium soft 3D, glossy pearl white, ice blue, lavender, pale peach, subtle gold, rounded forms, bright diffused daylight, strongly defocused distant elements, very low contrast. No characters, text, UI, Sudoku board, logos, watermark, dark sky, neon, clutter or dense stars.

Keep the wide composition.

assets.name: 35_time_attack_stopwatch
assets.promptOverride: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated Time Attack mode icon for GridNova Sudoku, square 1:1 canvas, actual transparent background. Create one compact futuristic stopwatch, instantly recognizable at 48–72 pixels. Rounded pearl-white glossy plastic body with lavender and icy-blue trim, dark navy clock face for legibility, simple pale-gold clock hands suggesting countdown, one softly beveled top button and a small rounded side button. A subtle orbital ring around the watch suggests the light-space world. Soft premium casual mobile game 3D, friendly calm pastel sci-fi, rounded geometry, bright diffused studio daylight from upper left, gentle ambient occlusion. Large centered object filling 80–85% of the canvas with clear margins, no clipping. Palette white, lavender, periwinkle, icy blue, pale gold, tiny navy contrast accents. No text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, checkerboard, backdrop, card, pedestal, dark sky, gritty metal, realistic machinery, red dominant colors, hard neon or excessive sparkles. Match GridNova's generated soft 3D planet and robot assets.
